It uses a consumer Yahoo domain rather than m3radio.com, so domain alignment is not claimed. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.

activityVerification.evidence: The official page carries a 2026 copyright notice and links to an active Live365 station profile describing new independent music, a now-playing area and current genres including Electro, Underground Hip-Hop, Classic Jazz, Heavy Metal and Rock & Roll.

deduplication.repositoryEvidence: Repository code search returned no existing canonical match for YardHype Radio, UnityXM Radio or M3 Radio by official platform name, route, domain or published submission address before creation.
deduplication.consolidation: YardHype's fan-chart and paid-promotion pages, UnityXM's request/suggest interfaces and third-party directory contacts, and M3's Live365 player and social profiles were retained as evidence or boundaries rather than duplicated as separate opportunities.

notes: Three legitimate opportunities were queued as needs_manual_review. No email was sent, no form field was filled, no audio or artwork was uploaded, no licence or consent was accepted, no vote was cast, no login was attempted, no CAPTCHA or anti-spam control was bypassed and no payment or submission action was completed.
